questions.question: If the complement of an angle x is equal to the supplement of angle 4x and the supplement of an angle y is 4 times its complement, then what is the value of (x + y) ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

From the first condition: 90° − x = 180° − 4x → 3x = 90° → x = 30°

From the second condition: 180° − y = 4 × (90° − y) → 3y = 180° → y = 60°

Required sum = x + y = 30° + 60° = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

questions.question: Supplementary angle of 130º angle is :
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

When the sum of two angles is 180°, then the angles are known as supplementary angles

**Calculation:**

Let's assume that the supplementary angle of 130º angle is x

⇒ x + 130 = 180

⇒ x = 180 - 130 = 50° 

**∴ The correct answer is 50° **

questions.question: How many lines can be drawn from a single point?
questions.solution:
An infinite number of lines can be drawn from a single point, as lines can extend in unlimited directions around the point, allowing for endless possibilities.

**So, From a single point, you can draw infinite lines.**

questions.question:
In the given figure, if AB||CD, AO = 4 cm; OC = (4x - 2) cm; OD = (2x + 4) cm; OB = (x + 1) cm, then the value of x is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/756b7d368dd8498e550ee4666f3e1f3e293775a321c025a7e4d737cab13f26e0.png]
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In the given figure, AB||CD, AO = 4 cm; OC = (4x - 2) cm; OD = (2x + 4) cm; OB = (x + 1) cm,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/756b7d368dd8498e550ee4666f3e1f3e293775a321c025a7e4d737cab13f26e0.png] 

**Concept used:**

The diagonals of a Trapezium divide each other proportionally

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

(OC/OA) = (OD/OB)

⇒ (4x - 2)/4 = (2x + 4)/(x + 1)

⇒ 2(2x - 1)/4 = (2x + 4)/(x + 1)

⇒ (2x - 1)/2 = (2x + 4)/(x + 1)

⇒ (2x - 1)(x + 1) = 2(2x + 4)

⇒ (2x - 1)(x + 1) = (4x + 8)

⇒ (2x² - x) + (2x - 1) = (4x + 8)

⇒ (2x2 + x - 1) = (4x + 8)

⇒ (2x2 + x - 1) - (4x + 8) = 0

⇒ (2x2 - 3x - 9) = 0

By factorization method,

⇒ (2x2 + 3x - 6x - 9) = 0

⇒ x(2x + 3)- 3(2x + 3) = 0

⇒ (2x + 3) or (x - 3) = 0

The value of x will be either -3/2 or 3

If value of x is kept -3/2 in OB then the value will be negative 

Hence the value of x is 3

**∴ The value of x is 3.**

In the given figure, TS || PR, ∠PRQ = 45° and ∠TQS = 75°. Find ∠TSQ.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81e2356f14ff9b5bf2c7a7b04f1aa231fd6b5fc33911f2fa50492acb86b6a3ef.png]
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since line TS is parallel to PR, corresponding angles are equal.

⇒ ∠QTS = ∠PRQ = 45°.

In ΔTQS, the sum of all interior angles is 180°.

⇒ ∠TSQ = 180° − (∠TQS + ∠QTS)

⇒ ∠TSQ = 180° − (75° + 45°) = 60°.

**∴ The correct answer is 60°.**
